hypotheses.justification: Recover this from the retained [P.flip.IsReduced]. The perfect pairings P.toLinearMap and P.flip.toLinearMap give reflexivity via Module.IsReflexive.of_isPerfPair, hence torsion-freeness of both modules via Module.IsReflexive.to_isTorsionFree. RootPairing.instFlipIsReduced applied to P.flip then gives P.IsReduced, since P.flip.flip = P definitionally. Install these local instances and use the original proof. This requires no nonempty index or nontrivial module assumption.

Recover this from the retained [P.IsReduced]. Use Module.IsReflexive.of_isPerfPair on P.toLinearMap and P.flip.toLinearMap, then Module.IsReflexive.to_isTorsionFree to obtain torsion-freeness of both modules. RootPairing.instFlipIsReduced applied to P supplies the deleted instance, after which the original proof works unchanged. Empty index types and trivial modules cause no exception.
